title: Replication protein A prevents unregulated priming and Rad51 loading on single-stranded DNA in nuclear extracts of Xenopus eggs
authors: Taisei Miyata; Naoki Tani; Yoshitaka Kawasoe; Kei-ichiro Ishiguro; Tatsuro S. Takahashi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究RPA在非洲爪蟾卵核提取物中调控ssDNA引发和Rad51装载的机制，属于蛋白质-ssDNA互作，但非TF-DNA体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅湿实验，故评分较低。
abstract: In eukaryotes, single-stranded DNA (ssDNA) generated during DNA replication, recombination, and repair is rapidly bound and protected by the major single-stranded DNA-binding protein replication protein A (RPA). RPA not only stabilizes ssDNA but also acts as a central platform that coordinates diverse DNA transactions. Exhaustion of RPA due to unregulated ssDNA production leads to replication fork breakage and replication catastrophe, underscoring its critical role in genome stability. However, the direct consequences of RPA limitation remain incompletely understood. Using Xenopus egg extracts, we show that excess ssDNA induces spontaneous priming, a reaction that is otherwise prevented in a physiological nuclear environment. We provide evidence that priming suppression is mediated by stoichiometric binding of RPA to ssDNA. Analysis of the ssDNA-binding proteome reveals that RPA promotes the association of ATR checkpoint factors, Polα–primase, and the RFWD3 ubiquitin ligase with ssDNA. In contrast, RPA depletion induces the recruitment of Rad51, Rad51 paralogs, and Fbh1, a DNA helicase that interacts with both RPA and Rad51 and promotes fork breakage under replication stress. Collectively, our findings suggest that RPA contributes to genome stability by protecting ssDNA from inappropriate DNA synthesis and unscheduled recruitment of recombination and fork-processing factors.
abstract_zh: 在真核生物中，DNA复制、重组和修复过程中产生的单链DNA（ssDNA）会被主要的单链DNA结合蛋白——复制蛋白A（RPA）迅速结合并保护。RPA不仅稳定ssDNA，还充当协调多种DNA交易的中央平台。由于不受调控的ssDNA产生导致RPA耗竭，会引发复制叉断裂和复制灾难，凸显了其在基因组稳定性中的关键作用。然而，RPA限制的直接后果仍未完全阐明。利用非洲爪蟾卵提取物，我们表明过量的ssDNA诱导自发引发，而这种反应在生理性核环境中通常被阻止。我们提供证据表明，引发抑制是由RPA对ssDNA的化学计量结合介导的。对ssDNA结合蛋白质组的分析揭示，RPA促进ATR检查点因子、Polα–引发酶以及RFWD3泛素连接酶与ssDNA的关联。相反，RPA耗竭则诱导Rad51、Rad51旁系同源物以及Fbh1（一种与RPA和Rad51均相互作用并在复制应激下促进叉断裂的DNA解旋酶）的招募。总体而言，我们的发现表明，RPA通过保护ssDNA免受不当DNA合成以及重组和叉加工因子的非计划性招募，从而促进基因组稳定性。
